Streaming chat completion via the Google Vertex AI provider using the vertex_ai/ prefix — verifies SSE chunks from the Gemini streaming endpoint are yielded and assembled correctly

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:liter_llm/liter_llm.dart';
import 'package:liter_llm/src/liter_llm_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final req = await createChatCompletionRequestFromJson(json: '{"max_tokens":32,"messages":[{"content":"Count to three, one word per response.","role":"user"}],"model":"vertex_ai/gemini-2.0-flash","stream":true}');
    final apiKey = Platform.environment['API_KEY'];
      if (apiKey == null || apiKey.isEmpty) { throw StateError('API_KEY must be set'); }
      final client = await LiterLlmBridge.createClient(apiKey);
    final result = await client.chatStream(req: req).toList();
    for (final resultChunk in result) {
    stdout.writeln(resultChunk);
    }
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
